changelog.content:
## Fixes

- Prevented simultaneous UoT Hub connections from replacing authenticated
  return paths. Both directions now use keepalive below the path deadline,
  including legacy Core configurations. Connect attempts and shutdown remain
  bounded while output queues are backpressured.
- Added verified AXF1 Fake TCP datagram framing to tolerate middlebox segment
  splitting and coalescing, with raw-format legacy handshake negotiation.
- Detect TCP middleboxes using a capability option and cookie-bound carrier
  negotiation. Those paths use bounded cumulative ACK recovery, ordered
  fragment delivery, and retransmission; native Fake TCP peers retain datagram
  loss semantics. Core status identifies TCP compatibility peers.
- Corrected Fake TCP TUN receive capacity and reserved the complete framing
  overhead in the overlay MTU. A stalled send direction and outer FIN now
  retire the carrier tuple instead of remaining behind incoming keepalive.
- Added a time-bounded carrier verification example using a separate subnet,
  independent root-private identities, and the production Core runtime.

## Compatibility

- Upgrade every Master/Slave and its Core before testing framed Fake TCP
  through a TCP proxy. Legacy raw peers still require preserved datagram
  boundaries. Mesh identities and signed update authorization are unchanged.
